text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The race to determine the final number one of the year.
Hehe, looks like everyone's completely fired up.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm even more prepared.
I've been preparing endlessly just for this day.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, keep your eyes on me until the very end.
And expect great things from me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Faster and stronger than anyone else,
to reach the moment where I become number one."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm off.
—I'm going to take first place, second to none.
